title: Umuzigo w'ubutunzi
intro: Uhagaze imbere y’inkuru y’ubutunzi bwinshi cane, ubuzima busharije inzahabu n’ububasha, yamara amaherezo ni icigwa co kugabisha abo bose barondera ubukuru bwo mw’isi. Woba ushobora gusobanura akaranga k’uwo muntu inkuru yiwe isubiramwo mu gihe cose, kikaba ari ikimenyamenya c’uko amatunga yo mw’isi ari ay’igihe gito?
clues: Nari mu bantu b’Umuhanuzi akomeye, ariko nahisemwo inzira y’ubwibone n’agahahazo.
Allah yampaye ubutunzi bwinshi cane, ku buryo imfunguruzo z’ubutunzi bwanje zari umuzigo uremereye ku mugwi w’abantu ukomeye.
Abantu banje barampaye impanuro yo kutanezerwa n’ubutunzi bwanje, banyibutsa ko Allah adakunda abanezerwa.
Naravuga n’ubwibone ko ubutunzi bwanje bwinshi bwavuye ku bumenyi bwanje n’inguvu zanje bwite, atari umuhezagiro wa Allah.
Naragabishijwe ku bijanye n’ugusesagura, nkibutswa kurondera iherezo ry’iherezo n’ivyo Allah yampaye, ariko nanse kwumviriza, mbandanya mu bwibone bwanje.
Amaherezo, Allah yatumye isi inmira n’aho mba, nsiga ata n’umwe mfasha kurwanya itegeko ryiwe.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
